description: Horse racing entries from Equibase's free entry pages for a track and date (e.g. BEL, 2026-10-22): race card with purse, type, distance, surface, starters and post time; with a race number, the field with program number, post position, horse, age/sex, medication, jockey, weight, trainer and morning-line odds. US tracks (CAN for Canada). No past performances or results. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

race.description: Race number 1-20 for the field (optional; without it the race card is returned)

track.description: Equibase track code, e.g. BEL, SA, CD, GP, KEE, WO
